decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Design and Access Statement, Location Plan 1:1250, 1799-01, 1815-03, 1815-04, 1815-05, 1815-06, 1815-05P, 1815-03P, 1815-04P, 1815-06P.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2  of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policies SD1 and SD2 of the Redignton Frognall Neighbourhood Plan 2021. 
Condition : 4 - Detailed drawings, or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the relevant part of the work is begun: 
a)  Details of new downpipes including material, finish and method of fixing.             
b) Plan, elevation and section drawings of all new windows at a scale of 1:10 with typical glazing bar details at 1:1.  


Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the building in accordance with the requirements of policy D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Bundled minor external alterations to a maisonette in the Redington Frognal Conservation Area. (1) Removal of an existing timber-framed, single-glazed glass roof structure over the front light well (approximately 10 cubic metres) and installation of a 1,100mm high matt black painted mild steel safety railing around the open light well, in accordance with Approved Document K. (2) Same-line replacement of two existing cast-iron rainwater downpipes (DP1 front elevation; DP2 rear elevation) with black uPVC rainwater downpipes (no relocation at either pipe; same gully or termination at each). (3) Removal of a non-original timber-framed canopy with ceramic tile covering over the basement (Garden Flat) entrance and installation of a replacement aluminium-framed door canopy with polycarbonate roofing panel (Canopia Venus 1350; 1,355 mm wide × 880 mm projection × 355 mm deep). (4) Replacement of five timber casement windows W1-W5 (all on the front elevation) and one rear-elevation glazed timber door set D1 and windows (kitchen), like-for-like in casement opening method, sightlines and ovolo moulding, in Meranti hardwood with double-glazed sealed units. Net new floorspace: zero.
subdivision_of_building: All works relate to 4B Kidderpore Avenue which is part of a larger building.
